name: Gina Lestrade
original_name: ジーナ・レストレード
source:
An orphaned teen living in London's slums utilizing her pickpocketing skills to get by. 
[SPOILER]
After being accused of murder, she became a detective-in-training studying under Tobias Gregson near the end of the Victorian Era.
[/SPOILER]
[Taken from [URL=https://aceattorney.fandom.com/wiki/Gina_Lestrade?so=search] her Ace Attorney Wiki page[/URL].]
